payload.claim: `_apply_criterion_probes`'s docstring still says `pairs` holds 'one pair per probe of each criterion-probe entry, then each wrong version paired with its criterion,' describing only two sources. The caller in `_drive_cell` now appends a third source, each parent's wrong-version pair from `parent_versions.parent_version_pairs`, before calling this function, so the docstring's enumeration of what `pairs` holds is no longer complete.
